--- grant_queue.sql
GRANT INSERT ON QUEUE Q TO ROLE producer

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.PrivilegeOnQueue{
    Privileges: []ast.TablePrivilege{
      &ast.InsertPrivilege{
        Insert: 6,
        Rparen: -1,
      },
    },
    Names: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 22,
        NameEnd: 23,
        Name:    "Q",
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 32,
      NameEnd: 40,
      Name:    "producer",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT INSERT ON QUEUE Q TO ROLE producer
